title: Reverse Transcription of RNA to cDNA
author: Igem Dusseldorf
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8bjhskn
materials: Prepare a Mastermix of the following reagents: 4 µL 5x RT-buffer 2 µL dNTP Mix (10 mM of each nucleotide) 1 µL RevertAid Reverse Transcriptase

steps.title: Prepare yellow sample buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a diluted yellow sample buffer by mixing 33.25 µL of 40x yellow sample buffer with 966.75 µL of H2O.

steps.title: Assemble RT reactions
steps.instruction: In PCR stripes, pipet the following components for each reaction:

substeps.instruction: Add RNase-free H2O to reach a volume of 13 µL

steps.title: Add Mastermix
steps.instruction: Add 7 µL of Mastermix to each reaction.

steps.title: Prepare -RT control
steps.instruction: Prepare a -RT control by pipetting 100 ng RNA into PCR stripes, omitting the buffer and other reagents, and adding H2O to a final volume of 20 µL. Mark the tube as -RT.

steps.title: Add diluted sample buffer
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL of 1.33x yellow sample buffer to each reaction.

steps.title: Store cDNA
steps.instruction: Store the resulting cDNA at 4 ˚C for short-term storage or freeze at -20 ˚C for long-term storage.
